headlines.title_en: A-share Close: ChiNext Index Opens Low and Closes High, Up 1.49%; Consumer Stocks Active in Afternoon
headlines.summary_en: China's three major A-share indices closed higher today. The Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.32%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.09%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.49%, the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 rose 0.23%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 1.61%. Total market turnover reached 2.1672 trillion yuan, down 168.4 billion yuan from the previous day, with over 4,100 stocks advancing. By sector, real estate, optical fiber concepts, CPO, communication equipment, and education led gains; oil and gas extraction and services, combustible ice, fentanyl, and coal mining and processing led losses. In trading, the real estate sector continued to rally in the afternoon, with Binjiang Group, Urban Development, Rongsheng Development, Zhongjiao Development, and Shoucheng Holdings hitting limit-up, while Tefa Services, Huayuan Holdings, and China Merchants Shekou led gains. The optical fiber concept stayed strong all day, with Changjin Photonics and Focuslight Technologies hitting 20cm limit-up, and Zhichun Technology, Tongding Interconnection, and Yongding Co.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers: New Energy Vehicle Monthly New Car Sales Share Exceeds 60% for First Time
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on the 12th shows that in July 2026, the monthly sales share of new energy vehicles exceeded 60% for the first time, and the cumulative share exceeded 50% for the first time; monthly exports exceeded 1 million vehicles for two consecutive months, with NEV export share exceeding 50% for two straight months. In the first seven months, China's auto production and sales reached 17.567 million and 17.602 million units respectively, with NEV production and sales at 9.014 million and 9.007 million units, both up nearly 10% year-on-year. In July, NEV production and sales were 1.576 million and 1.561 million units, up 26.8% and 23.7% year-on-year respectively, with pure electric vehicle production and sales both exceeding 1 million units, both up over 30% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing Markets Turnover Exceeds 2 Trillion Yuan, Down 179.3 Billion Yuan Compared to Same Time Previous Day
headlines.summary_en: According to Hithink RoyalFlush iFinD data, turnover across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets exceeded 2 trillion yuan, down 179.3 billion yuan compared to the same time the previous day, with full-day turnover estimated at around 2.1 trillion yuan. So far, Shanghai turnover is 912.1 billion yuan, Shenzhen is 1.0744 trillion yuan, and Beijing Stock Exchange 50 is 13.5 billion yuan.

headlines.title_en: Morning Close on August 12: ChiNext Index Rises 1.73% Half-Day, Computing Hardware Stocks Strengthen Collectively
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market rose in a volatile manner in the morning, with the ChiNext and STAR indices leading gains. Computing hardware stocks rallied collectively, with multiple stocks including Focuslight Technologies, Yongding Co., and Tongding Interconnection hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks surged, with Xiandao Jidian gaining 3 boards in 4 days and Zhichun Technology hitting limit-up. Innovative drug concepts remained active, with Baihua Pharma hitting 7 consecutive limit-ups, and Zhejiang Medicine and Yuhuan Pharma hitting limit-up. On the downside, oil and gas and coal sectors fell, with New Dazhou A and Shouhua Gas down over 5%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,600 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and morning turnover at 1.39 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.32%, Shenzhen Component rose 1.25%, and ChiNext rose 1.73%. 2. By sector, computing hardware, semiconductor chips, healthcare, and AI applications led gains; oil and gas, coal, power, and banking led losses. 3. headlines.title: 连续两个月突破100万辆 我国汽车出口延续强劲增长态势
headlines.summary: 从中国汽车工业协会获悉，7月份我国汽车出口表现亮眼，延续强劲增长态势。最新发布的数据显示，今年7月份，汽车出口104.3万辆，环比增长0.6%，同比增长81.3%。其中，新能源汽车出口55.3万辆，环比增长5.7%，同比增长145.5%。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Exceeding 1 Million Vehicles for Two Consecutive Months, China's Auto Exports Continue Strong Growth Momentum
headlines.summary_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, July auto exports performed strongly, sustaining robust growth momentum. Latest data shows that in July, auto exports reached 1.043 million units, up 0.6% month-on-month and 81.3% year-on-year. Among them, NEV exports were 553,000 units, up 5.7% month-on-month and 145.5% year-on-year. (CCTV News)
